info.name: Cross Border Command — DB Backup Email APIs
info.description:
All database-backup send endpoints (super-admin only). Auto-sends a gzip pg_dump every 15 days; these expose the same pipeline on demand.

Setup: set collection variables `base_url` (default http://127.0.0.1:8000) and `token`. Run 'Login' first to auto-populate `token`.

request.description: Standard email+password login. Test script stores the returned Sanctum token into the `token` collection variable used by the backup requests.

GET /api/backup/email/status — when the last DB backup went out, when it's next due (15-day cycle), the configured recipients, and whether it's due now / ever sent.

Response:
{
  "interval_days": 15,
  "recipients": ["php@inhpl.com"],
  "last_sent_at": null,
  "last_sent_human": null,
  "next_due_at": null,
  "is_due_now": true,
  "ever_sent": false
}

POST /api/backup/email/send — generate a full pg_dump of the whole DB right now, gzip it, and email it to BACKUP_EMAIL_RECIPIENTS (php@inhpl.com). Bypasses the 15-day gate and re-stamps the marker so the scheduled clock resets.

Response:
{
  "message": "Backup emailed successfully.",
  "recipients": ["php@inhpl.com"],
  "size_kb": 342,
  "sent_at": "2026-07-31T..."
}

Same as Send now, but `to` overrides the recipients for this one run (comma-separated). Values are trimmed, lowercased, de-duped and validated; invalid addresses are dropped. Returns 422 if none are valid.
